entry.title: Ride on the web
entry.hint: Indoor cycling on a big screen. Your phone bridges the sensors, the game runs in the browser.

join.title: Join the game
join.steps: Open {{url}} in a laptop or TV browser and type the 6 digit code shown there. Or scan its QR with the phone camera and JoyoFit opens right away.
join.fromLink: The code from the QR is filled in. Check it matches the screen, then tap Join.
join.account: Needs a JoyoRogo account signed in to JoyoFit. Free, no Pro needed.
join.ride: Joining gets an indoor ride recording ready on your phone. It saves like any ride, with the game's distance and climb.

error.notSignedIn: Sign in to JoyoRogo first to use Ride on the web.
error.notConfigured: This build has no JoyoFit server set up.
error.notFound: Code not found or expired. A code lasts 10 minutes, ask for a new one on the screen.
error.taken: Another phone already uses this room.
error.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
error.busy: Another recording is running. Finish it first, then join.
error.prepare: The recording could not get ready. Check Bluetooth permission and your sensors.
error.replaced: Another phone took over this room.
error.expired: The room closed after sitting idle for too long.
error.policy: The server closed the connection because of the data it received.
error.lost: The connection dropped and has not come back.

status.title: Status
status.gameWaiting: Waiting for the game to open

lobby.title: Ready to ride
lobby.hint: Start from the game, or tap Start here. The recording runs on the phone, so keep JoyoFit open.
lobby.noSensors: No cadence or heart rate sensor is paired. Add one under Sensors first.
lobby.preparing: Getting the recording and sensors ready...

live.title: In the game
live.waiting: Waiting for data from the game
live.note: Distance, speed and power here come from the game's simulation. Power is an estimate from cadence and gear, not a measurement.

actions.leaveMessage: The game stops getting data from your phone. A recording that already started carries on as a normal indoor ride.
